'''2015 San Diego Grand Prix Results Jonathan Murray DS Tatooine: Jabba's Palace''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Jonathan Murray]] at [[2015 San Diego Grand Prix]] (Results).

== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Jonathan Murray]]
* '''Event:''' [[2015 San Diego Grand Prix]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Tatooine: Jabba's Palace|JP-D-tatooinejabbaspalace.gif}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Start Your Engines!|Tat-D-startyourengines.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Results
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2015-san-diego-grand-prix/ PC list]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261013130400/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/2015-san-diego-grand-prix.html Internet Archive]
